description: Three input mixer feeding a discrete transistor ladder low pass filter that self-oscillates

params.text: Attenuates the filtered mix, silent at the bottom and full amplitude at the top
Sets the level of that channel into the filter, roughly unity gain at the centre and soft clipping overdrive above it
Sets the cutoff frequency of the low pass filter, roughly 250Hz to 13KHz
Tunes the cutoff finely around the frequency set by COARSE
Sets the depth of linear frequency modulation applied to the cutoff
Sets the inverted feedback around the filter, accentuating the cutoff and self-oscillating as a sine wave at its maximum

inputs.text: An audio input, scaled by its own level fader and mixed with the others before the filter
Shifts the cutoff at a volt per octave, and tracks pitch when the filter self-oscillates
Linear frequency modulation of the cutoff, scaled by the LIN FM attenuator

outputs.text: The mixed inputs after the low pass filter, at the level set by the LEVEL fader

inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
